title: The MacBook Pro's OLED PWM problem
why_read: A concrete hardware complaint about OLED PWM dimming on a widely used laptop, relevant to engineers who care about display tech and eye strain.
analysis: This piece likely documents that Apple's new OLED MacBook Pro screens use pulse-width modulation for brightness control at low levels, which can cause flicker perceptible or uncomfortable to some users. PWM-based dimming is a known tradeoff in OLED displays versus the backlight dimming used in LCDs, and it has real implications for eye strain and headaches for sensitive users. This is a useful, specific hardware engineering topic with practical consequences for a broad audience of laptop buyers and developers.
